sentences.text:

Advocates for Petitioners : -
Advocates for Respondents : Mrs. Devi Subhashini Anne,
 Standing Counsel for Endowments  Mr. T. S. Rayalu,
 G.P. for Endowments
CORAM : THE CHIEF JUSTICE DHIRAJ SINGH THAKUR
SRI JUSTICE RAVI CHEEMALAPATI
DATE : 9th July 2025 PC:

The present application has been filed seeking permission of this Court and modification of the order, dated 30.05.2006, to the extent of lands, details whereof are reflected in this application,
which are stated to be endowment lands belonging to Sri Amareshwara Swamy Vari Devastanam,
Amaravati, Palnadu District, Andhra Pradesh, is required for acquisition for a public purpose.

However, the land in question is situate in the State of Telangana.
We have heard learned counsel for the parties.
Learned counsel representing the Temple i.e. Sri Amareshwara Swamy Vari Devastanam has no objection for the acquisition of the subject endowment properties for a public purpose.

HCJ & RCJ We, therefore, permit the acquisition of the subject lands and direct that the compensation be paid in regard to the lands so acquired, which should not be less than the D. Kodanda Rama Sharma vs The Govt. Of A.P. on 9 July, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/94506840/

sentences.text:
1 compensation which may be fixed in the Award which might be passed in regard to the land which is sought to be acquired from other private parties, and in case, the landholders whose land has been acquired are not satisfied with the compensation awarded as per the Award and prefer an appeal,
then the benefit of the enhancement of the compensation should also be given to the temple in regard to the subject land on the basis that the land which is sought to be acquired by the parties is in close proximity to the land belonging to the temple.

It shall also be open to the temple authorities or any devotee on behalf of the temple, to independently prefer an appeal seeking higher compensation in appeal proceedings under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
